narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Remove a corner! Corners are the hardest squares to reach.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>A corner is white, so that leaves seven white and seven black.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>The colours balance, and we already saw such a grid tiled.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows a white corner removed; the counts become 7 and 7; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Remove any black square, and the colours can no longer balance.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Your turn. Remove the white square in row three, column one, and find a tiling.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the line remove a black square to break the balance appears; then the grid with a white square removed appears with an empty box
